title: THE HOSPITAL
content: This thread can be for recounting experiences at the hospital if there isn't one similar to this yet. &#x200B; Here's my personal least favorite experience there: &#x200B; Basically I had some kind of horrible dark warehouse job, and my boss took me to dinner. Upon getting to the restaurant, he smiles creepily and I notice all the food is made out of human meat. The waiters have no face but psychically force me to order a casserole made out of hands. I refuse to eat and they manhandle me down into some basement that was glowing red, literally just a long staircase with a spot for a person to sit at the bottom against a wall. The waiters held up raw human meat and forced it into my face. After this I was transferred to some hospital where they were trying to take my soul out of my body. The nurses were horrifying beyond description. One had a squid like head with no eyes, her lips were cut vertically flaying out her lips. The other just looked like a teratoma with a body attached. I had a friend in there and they pulled her soul out and maybe ate it. Thats when I escaped the bed and started running. First door I opened led to a bathroom which upon opening let out horrific sounds of liquid squelching, people howling in pain, tortured souls, and upon the wall I saw the shadow of what looked like a few different people being chopped up and recombined in weird terrifying ways, combined together and mangled or whatever but they couldn't die. Needless to say I went to find a different door. The next one led to the parking lot. This basically ended the dream.
